summary: Full regression + Senses Pack + K-7 UI/UX verification. All required testids exist; landing badge shows 'Made for Grades K–7'; 8 grade cards (K..7) all visible; Hub shows 'Learning Academy' (not 'Math Academy'); Academy page shows 6 subject cards (addition, subtraction, multiplication, fractions, shapes, counting); battle question SpeechButton ('battle-speech-btn') renders, is clickable with NO console errors; level-up banner appears after ~3-4 won K battles with confetti <canvas> rendered; grade-specific questions verified (Grade 3 → addition/subtraction/multiplication; Grade 7 → algebra/fractions/percents); egg auto-hatch at /egg works (both eggs hatched, 'A new friend appeared', confetti canvas rendered, newly-hatched companions appear in /collection as owned); Parent dashboard PIN 1234 unlocks stats; localStorage persists across reloads. Zero console errors across the entire flow.

issues: Step text still says 'Train pals at the Math Academy.' — should be 'Learning Academy' to stay consistent with the rest of the app rename. File: /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx line 97.

action_items: Minor copy fix: /app/frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx line 97 — change 'Train pals at the Math Academy.' to 'Train pals at the Learning Academy.' for consistency with the renamed feature.
critical_code_review_comments: Battle.tsx is large (~480 lines including helpers). Consider splitting battle UI, battle state machine, and question runner into separate modules for maintainability.

ACADEMY_SUBJECTS card_id naming uses subject ids ('multiplication' etc.) — make sure new academy subjects (multiplication, fractions) have placeholder mini-game routes/content so kids don't hit dead-end cards.
Landing.tsx copy still references 'Math Academy' — would be cleaner to centralise the brand string in one constant to avoid future drift.

On EggHatch auto-hatch, both eggs can hatch in the same visit when both are at 100% — the 'reveal' animation only highlights the most recently hatched companion. If product wants per-egg reveal sequence, this is worth a UX pass.
seed_data_creation: Used localStorage to bump both eggs.progress=100 to exercise the auto-hatch flow on /egg without grinding through ~60+ battles. Player setup done via UI (Testy / Grade K / Spriggle).
